readings: For films whose `replacement_cost` is more than 20.99, group by `rating` and show, for each rating, the rating, the average `length` (ignoring missing values), and the average per film of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length) AS average_length,
  AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_rate_per_day
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
GROUP BY rating
